text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
explanation: Paul asked three times for his suffering to be removed. The answer was not removal but sufficiency. The word 'sufficient' means 'it is enough for you right now.' This is not comfort from a distance — it is presence in the difficulty.
reflection: Is there a weakness you've been trying to hide from God, as if He doesn't already see it?
application: Tell someone one honest thing about where you're struggling today.
memory: Weakness is where His strength finds room.
prayer: Lord, I don't want to be weak. But I'm learning that weak is where You work. Amen.
